_meta.description: Plan switching from a long panel (one row per customer per month-end snapshot, rows not sorted by customer): ATTR_PREVIOUS_STATE adds each row's plan at the same customer's previous snapshot, typed as plan with plan's dictionary, so a prev_plan x plan crosstab counts the moves with plan names on both axes. Each customer's first snapshot has no previous plan and drops from the row axis.
_meta.name: previous_state_transitions
